beats.say: Five teams want machine learning this quarter.
Pick the right tool for each, then put one model into production and keep it healthy.
beats.label: Station 4.5 · ML on Google Cloud
beats.head: Pick, train, serve, monitor

check.prompt: You need fields from scanned invoices. No labels, no ML team. Which tool?
check.why: Invoice parsing is already solved by a pre-trained API.

beats.say: The rule: the least effort that meets the need.
If Google already solves the task, call the API. Vision, Natural Language, Speech, Translation, Document AI.
beats.label: Step one
beats.head: A pre-trained API

beats.say: Your own labels and no coders? AutoML. Data in BigQuery and a SQL team? BigQuery ML.
beats.label: Then

beats.say: Full control of the model? Custom training on Vertex AI.
beats.label: Last
beats.head: Custom training
beats.text: TensorFlow, PyTorch or XGBoost on Vertex AI

check.prompt: A huge TensorFlow model of matrix multiplications takes weeks on GPUs. What helps most?
check.why: TPUs are built for large matrix multiplications.

beats.say: Training hardware. CPUs for small models. GPUs for most deep learning.
beats.label: Hardware

beats.say: TPUs for huge models full of matrix multiplications, with no custom operations.
beats.label: TPU
beats.head: Huge, matrix-heavy models

beats.say: If the GPUs sit idle, fix the input pipeline. TFRecord files and prefetching.
beats.label: Idle accelerators
beats.head: Fix the input pipeline

beats.say: To tune hyperparameters, Vertex AI uses Bayesian optimization. Fewer trials than a grid search.
beats.label: Hyperparameter tuning
beats.head: Smarter than a grid search

check.prompt: You score forty million customers every night. How?
check.why: Nobody waits for the answer, so no endpoint needs to run all day.

beats.say: An online endpoint answers one request in milliseconds. You pay while it runs.
beats.label: Online
beats.head: An endpoint: milliseconds

beats.say: Batch prediction scores millions of rows offline, then stops.
beats.label: Batch
beats.head: Batch: millions of rows, then stop

beats.say: A feature store gives training and serving the same features. No skew.
beats.label: Feature Store
beats.head: Same features, no skew

beats.say: Models get worse as the world changes.
Skew: serving data differs from training data. Drift: serving data changes over time.
beats.label: Model Monitoring

beats.say: A pipeline retrains on old and new data, and deploys only if the new model is better.
beats.label: Vertex AI Pipelines
beats.head: Retrain on old + new data

beats.say: Least effort wins. TPUs for huge models. Batch when nobody waits. Monitor, then retrain.
beats.label: Station 4.5
